title: wpf-ar(A4): AllocParser C# helper for AllocationTick attribution
description:
~100-line C# helper using TraceEvent NuGet to parse AllocationTick events from .nettrace.

Files: tools/alloc-parser/AllocParser.csproj (new), tools/alloc-parser/Program.cs (new)

Acceptance:
- Uses Microsoft.Diagnostics.Tracing.TraceEvent NuGet
- CLI: AllocParser.exe <nettrace> --output <json> [--top N]
- Parses AllocationTick events, attributes AllocationAmount bytes to every frame in the alloc call stack (inclusive attribution, same logic as speedscope CPU)
- Filters output to WPF namespaces (same set as WPF_NAMESPACE_PATTERNS in profile.py)
- Output JSON: [{frame, alloc_bytes}, ...] sorted desc
- Empty array (not error) when no AllocationTick events
- Targets net10.0-windows; publishes self-contained win-x64
- Build: dotnet publish -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained
- Independent of A1-A3; can be authored in parallel

Test: Run against a known .nettrace with DotNETRuntime keyword 0x1FFBCCBFF; verify >=1 frame with alloc_bytes>0. Run against empty trace -> empty array, exit 0.

Source: autoresearch/redesign/01-profile-design.md sec 3.2
close_reason: AllocParser builds + parses AllocationTick; tested on profile.nettrace (44358 events, 87 WPF frames, 231MB trace)
